verdict_rationale: Arena resolves every output path from the process CWD - there is no absolute, package-relative, or environment-driven artifact path anywhere in the package (the sole hardcoded absolute path, DONOR_ROOT, is read-only). Therefore work confined to my worktree physically cannot write into the live worktree's artifacts, and this was confirmed empirically by byte-identical before/after fingerprints across a full pytest+ruff+mypy run. The residual risk is not filesystem-based: it is (1) the shared Ollama daemon on 127.0.0.1:11434, which is a machine-wide singleton, (2) the shared git common dir, and (3) an editable-install .pth that makes bare console scripts silently operate on the main checkout instead of my worktree.
